title: JJK Techniques & Domains
description: Domain expansions, cursed techniques, and Black Flash!

questions.question: What does Gojo's Infinity technique do?

options.text: Slows objects approaching him to zero

questions.explanation: Infinity inserts an asymptotic distance, so things approach but never reach Gojo.

questions.question: What are Gojo's two cursed technique attacks called?

options.text: Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue and Cursed Technique Reversal: Red

questions.explanation: Blue attracts (lapse), Red repels (reversal), and Hollow Purple combines them.

questions.question: Sukuna's Dismantle is an attack that cuts targets with one stroke.
questions.explanation: Dismantle (Kaisen) cleaves enemies with a slashing cursed technique.

questions.question: What is Toge Inumaki's cursed technique?
questions.explanation: Inumaki's Cursed Speech forces compliance with whatever he says, so he limits speech to onigiri ingredients.

questions.question: Simple Domain is a counter to Domain Expansion's sure-hit effect.
questions.explanation: Simple Domain creates a 4-meter sphere that negates the sure-hit effect within its range.

questions.question: Which technique allows the user to manipulate blood?
questions.explanation: Blood Manipulation is the Kamo family's inherited technique, used by Noritoshi and Choso.

questions.question: What is Hakari Kinji's domain expansion called?
questions.explanation: Idle Death Gamble is a pachinko-themed domain that grants infinite cursed energy on jackpot.

questions.question: Black Flash applies 2.5x damage when cursed energy is applied within 0.000001 seconds of contact.
questions.explanation: Black Flash distorts space and multiplies the base damage by 2.5x.

questions.question: Which Kyoto sorcerer creates and pilots cursed corpses remotely?
questions.explanation: Muta's Heavenly Restriction confines him; he pilots Mechamaru via Puppet Manipulation.

questions.question: What is required to open a complete Domain Expansion?

options.text: A barrier and a sure-hit cursed technique

questions.explanation: Domain Expansion requires constructing an innate domain (barrier) and applying a sure-hit technique inside.
